assumptions.choice: The 60-candle level window and 100-candle touch-confirmation window are computed over the bars strictly preceding the current (signal) bar, using delayed lines (data.high(-1)/data.low(-1)) as the indicator input.
assumptions.reason: Spec is silent on whether 'last N candles' includes the current bar; including it would make the breakout condition (close beyond the extreme of a window containing the current bar's own high/low) structurally unreachable, so the level must be set from prior bars only.

assumptions.choice: SL and TP are implemented as native backtrader Stop and Limit child orders via buy_bracket/sell_bracket (OCO group), executing intrabar off High/Low; the 'entry price' used to compute the 2% take-profit target is the signal bar's close (the same price used to evaluate the breakout condition), since the bracket must be submitted before the market order's actual next-bar fill price is known.
assumptions.reason: Spec states SL/TP as price levels without specifying execution mechanics; native stop/limit orders are the literal, standard reading of 'stop-loss'/'take-profit' and give realistic intrabar triggering rather than only checking at bar close.

assumptions.choice: The 5-candle alternative-exit window is counted starting from the bar after the entry fill (bars_held 1..5); the fill bar itself is excluded.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'within 5 candles after entry', which reads as candles following the entry bar rather than including it.

assumptions.choice: ATR(14) is instantiated as an indicator but not referenced in any entry/exit condition.
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly allows adding ATR(14) 'only for volatility monitoring, without changing the entry/exit rules', so it is present per the spec's own wording but kept inert.

assumptions.choice: Volume confirmation uses strict '>' (volume > SMA*1.3) and touch confirmation uses '<=' (within 0.2% inclusive).
assumptions.reason: Spec wording ('volume > SMA... by 30%+', 'within 0.2%') most directly maps to these operators; declared since the spec does not give exact inequality boundaries.
